title: Naming the child before the family exists
odia: ମୁଳୁରୁ ମାଇପ ନାହିଁ ପୁଅ ନାଁ ଗୋପାଳ
literal_meaning: There is no wife to begin with, yet the son is named Gopal.
explanation: Plans have moved ahead of the conditions needed to carry them out. The family scene makes the missing first step conspicuous: a later detail has been settled while the basic situation is still imaginary. It can mock premature certainty rather than planning itself.
meaning_odia: ମୂଳ ଆୟୋଜନ ହୋଇନାହିଁ, ଅଥଚ ବହୁତ ପରର କଥାର ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ସରିଲାଣି। ପୁଅର ନାଁ ଠିକ୍ କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଏହି ଅକାଳ ନିଶ୍ଚିତତାକୁ ହସି କୁହାଯାଇଛି। କାମର ପ୍ରଥମ ଶର୍ତ୍ତଟି ପୂରଣ ହେବା ଆଗରୁ ଶେଷ ଫଳକୁ ନିଜର ବୋଲି ଧରିନେବା ହିଁ ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
usage_example: A club chooses the colour of its new building before securing any place to build it. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The wording uses a blunt term for wife and a familiar personal name. It documents a domestic image, not a rule about marriage, parenthood or a person’s entitlement to either.
